methodology.source_scope: Physical source *.cls/*.sty and *.tex below a gabarits directory; build/tmp/node_modules excluded
methodology.direct_reference_scope: Executable LaTeX commands and assembler literals; docs/tests excluded
methodology.fls_policy: Only .fls copied below audit/ beside a manifest git_sha are evidence; ignored build products and unattested recorders are omitted, and ATTESTED_CURRENT requires an exact HEAD SHA match
